questions.q: Q.24) With reference to National Land Monetization Corporation, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It is a 100% Government of India owned company. 2️⃣ It functions under the administrative control of the Department of Public Enterprises, Ministry of Finance. 3️⃣ It is mandated to identify Central Public Sector Enterprises for strategic disinvestment.
questions.e: NLMC is a 100% government-owned SPV under the Ministry of Finance focused on monetizing non-core assets. Identifying CPSEs for strategic disinvestment is the mandate of NITI Aayog, not NLMC.

questions.q: Q.25) Which one of the following countries is home to the world's largest hydroelectric power dam?
questions.e: China operates the Three Gorges Dam on the Yangtze River, currently the world's largest by installed capacity (22,500 MW). China has also approved the Tsangpo Dam project, which is expected to surpass the Three Gorges Dam in scale.

questions.q: Q.26) With reference to Off-Budget Borrowings in India, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ The off-budget borrowing is counted in the calculation of fiscal deficit of the government. 2️⃣ The repayment obligations of such borrowings are effectively guaranteed or serviced by government.
o: Statement I is correct, but Statement II is not correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains Statement I
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct but Statement II does not explain Statement I
Statement I is not correct, but Statement II is correct
questions.e: Off-budget borrowings are precisely designed to keep debt "off the books," meaning they are not included in the fiscal deficit calculation. However, the government remains liable for servicing these loans through future budgetary support.

questions.q: Q.27) As per the Domar Condition of Debt Sustainability, public debt of a country will be considered sustainable if:
o: The real interest rate is higher than the real GDP growth rate.
The real GDP growth rate is higher than the real interest rate.
The nominal interest rate is higher than the nominal GDP growth rate.
The primary deficit is continuously increasing as a proportion of GDP.
questions.e: Economist Evsey Domar established that debt is sustainable when the real GDP growth rate exceeds the real interest rate. This allows the economy to grow faster than the interest burden, stabilizing the debt-to-GDP ratio even with continued borrowing.

questions.q: Q.28) In the context of the external sector of the Indian economy, what does an increase in the Debt Service Ratio (DSR) indicate?
o: An increase in gross long term external debt service payment relative to short term.
An increase in the burden of gross external debt service payment relative to external current receipts.
An increase in foreign exchange reserves relative to gross external debt service.
A decrease in the share of external debt in total public debt.
questions.e: The DSR measures the proportion of gross external debt payments (principal + interest) to external current receipts. A higher ratio indicates that a larger portion of foreign exchange earnings is being used for debt repayment rather than other economic activities.

questions.q: Q.29) As per the Union Budget 2026-27, which of the following is expected to constitute the largest source of receipts for the Union Government?
questions.e: In the "Rupee Comes From" chart for Budget 2026-27, Borrowings and Other Liabilities constitute the largest single source at 24%. This is followed by Income Tax (21%), Corporation Tax (18%), and GST (15%).

questions.q: Q.30) Regarding the vacation of the seat of a Member of Parliament, which statement is incorrect?
o: If a person is elected to both Houses of Parliament and doesn't resign from one in 10 days, they lose the Lok Sabha seat.
If a person is elected to both Parliament and state legislature and doesn't resign from the latter in 14 days, the Parliament seat becomes vacant.
If an MP is absent for 60 consecutive days without permission, the House can declare the seat vacant.
A Member of Parliament may resign by submitting a letter to the Presiding Officer.
questions.e: Under the Representation of the People Act, 1951, if a person is elected to both Houses and fails to choose one within 10 days, it is the Rajya Sabha seat that becomes vacant, not the Lok Sabha seat.

questions.q: Q.31) Population of the year 2011 was first introduced in the tax devolution formula for sharing Union tax revenue with the States by:
questions.e: While the 15th Finance Commission increased the weight of the 2011 census, the 14th Finance Commission was actually the first to incorporate 2011 population data alongside 1971 data to balance demographic changes with population control efforts.

questions.q: Q.32) As per the Companies Act 2013, a 'Government Company' refers to any company in which:
o: Not less than 76% of the paid-up share capital is held by the Central or State Government.
Not less than 51% of the paid-up share capital is held by the Central or State Government.
Wholly 100% of the paid-up share capital is held by the Central or State Government.
Not less than 26% of the paid-up share capital is held by the Central or State Government.
questions.e: Section 2 of the Companies Act defines a Government Company as one where at least 51% of the paid-up capital is held by the Central Government, State Governments, or a combination thereof.

questions.q: Q.33) Consider the following parameters: 1️⃣ Per Capita GSDP distance 2️⃣ Contribution to GDP 3️⃣ Area 4️⃣ Tax/Fiscal Effort. How many of the above parameters are used for the horizontal devolution of taxes among States by the 16th Finance Commission of India?
questions.e: The 16th Finance Commission uses Per Capita GSDP Distance (42.5%), Area (10%), and the newly introduced Contribution to GDP (10%). It specifically excluded the "Tax and Fiscal Effort" parameter used by the previous commission.

questions.q: Q.34) How many of the following are examples of Non-Debt Capital Receipts (NDCR)? 1️⃣ Proceeds from disinvestment of public sector undertakings 2️⃣ Recovery of loans and advances given to State Governments 3️⃣ Market borrowings raised through issuance of government bonds.
questions.e: NDCR are capital receipts that do not create future repayment liabilities. Disinvestment proceeds and loan recoveries fit this criteria. Market borrowings are debt-creating receipts because they must be repaid with interest.

questions.q: Q.35) In context to the financial market, which of the following correctly indicates the utility of the 'Information Ratio'?
o: It measures how a portfolio fares relative to a benchmark considering return volatility.
It evaluates company performance relative to market capitalization.
It shows the ability of a company to pay interest on its debts.
It indicates the current share price of a company relative to its earnings.
questions.e: The Information Ratio measures a fund manager's skill in generating excess returns relative to a benchmark, adjusted for risk. A higher ratio indicates more consistent superior performance. SEBI recently mandated mutual funds to disclose this daily.

questions.q: Q.36) Consider the following statements regarding the Post Devolution Revenue Deficit (PDRD) Grant: 1️⃣ These are provided uniformly to all the states by the Union Government. 2️⃣ They were introduced for the first time on the recommendation of the Fifteenth Finance Commission.
questions.e: PDRD grants are not uniform; they are need-based and given only to states still facing a deficit after tax devolution. Furthermore, they are a long-standing constitutional mechanism under Article 275, not a new 15th Finance Commission invention.

questions.q: Q.37) Consider the following statements regarding the Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital Expenditure (SASCI): 1️⃣ The assistance is provided in the form of 50-year interest-free loans for capital projects. 2️⃣ A portion of the assistance is linked to states carrying out specific reforms.
questions.e: SASCI provides 50-year interest-free loans to boost state capital outlay. The scheme includes both "untied" funds for state priority projects and "reform-linked" funds for sectors like mining and vehicle scrapping.

questions.q: Q.38) If a government follows a counter-cyclical fiscal policy during an economic boom, which measures is it most likely to adopt? 1️⃣ Increasing tax rates 2️⃣ Reducing government expenditure 3️⃣ Expanding welfare spending 4️⃣ Launching a large infrastructure stimulus.
questions.e: In a boom, counter-cyclical policy aims to "cool" the economy via contractionary measures like raising taxes and cutting spending. Expanding welfare or infrastructure spending are expansionary measures suited for a recession, not a boom.

questions.q: Q.39) If the primary deficit of the Government is zero, then which of the following best describes its fiscal position?
o: The total amount of borrowing by the government is zero.
The current revenues are sufficient to meet non-interest expenditures.
The Government is borrowing only for the creation of capital assets.
The revenue receipts are sufficient to meet revenue expenditures.
questions.e: Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments. If it is zero, then Fiscal Deficit = Interest Payments. This means the government is borrowing exclusively to pay interest on past debts, while current revenue covers all other current spending.

questions.q: Q.40) With reference to the Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT) in India, which statement is correct?
o: It adjudicates disputes for both Defence Forces and CAPFs.
All proceedings before the Tribunal are conducted in the English language.
It does not have the authority to grant bail.
It functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).
questions.e: The AFT functions under the Ministry of Defence (not MHA) and does have the power to grant bail. Its jurisdiction is limited to the Army, Navy, and Air Force (excluding CAPFs). All its proceedings are conducted in English per the 2008 Procedure Rules.

questions.q: Q.41) Which department is responsible for the preparation and presentation of the Union Budget to the Parliament?
questions.e: The Department of Economic Affairs, within the Ministry of Finance, is the nodal agency for formulating fiscal policies and preparing the Annual Financial Statement (Budget) presented to Parliament.

questions.q: Q.42) What is the correct descending order of these sectors in terms of major expenditure allocation in the Union Budget 2026-27? 1️⃣ Transport 2️⃣ Defence 3️⃣ Education 4️⃣ Health.
questions.e: According to Budget 2026-27, Transport received the highest allocation (₹5,98,520 crore), followed by Defence (₹5,94,585 crore), Education (₹1,39,289 crore), and Health (₹1,04,599 crore).

questions.q: Q.43) Consider the following statements regarding the Self-Reliant India (SRI) Fund: 1️⃣ It provides equity support to MSMEs to help them expand. 2️⃣ It is managed by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI).
questions.e: The SRI Fund provides equity infusion to MSMEs via a Mother-Daughter fund structure. It is not managed by SIDBI; instead, NSIC Venture Capital Fund Limited is the Mother Fund and SBI Venture Capital Limited is the Investment Manager.

questions.q: Q.44) If the Union Budget for FY 2027-28 is presented, it will include which of the following receipts? 1️⃣ Budget Estimates (BE) for 2027-28 2️⃣ Revised Estimates (RE) for 2026-27 3️⃣ Actuals for 2025-26.
questions.e: Every Union Budget contains figures for three years: the projections for the upcoming year (BE), the revised realistic figures for the current ongoing year (RE), and the final audited figures for the previous year (Actuals).

questions.q: Q.45) Which benefit most likely accrues to people from the 'Swavalambini' initiative?
o: Women encouraged to conduct science research.
Pregnant women get access to antenatal care.
Female students cultivate an entrepreneurial mindset and access mentorship.
Forest-dwelling women empowered in resource management.
questions.e: Swavalambini is a Women Entrepreneurship Programme launched by the Ministry of Skill Development and NITI Aayog. It aims to provide female students in higher education with the skills, resources, and networks needed for entrepreneurship.

questions.q: Q.46) Based on Passage 1, which statement best reflects the critical message?
o: Material wealth should not be acquired at the cost of personal and social values.
A person needs material possessions for a decent living.
The contemporary world measures success in terms of material wealth.
Materialistic tendencies prioritize money above all else.
questions.e: The passage argues that while money is essential for dignity, the "real concern" is when it defines success and subordinates moral virtues like empathy and social responsibility, emphasizing that values should remain primary.

questions.q: Q.47) What is the most logical inference from Passage 2 regarding the Amazon rainforest?
o: Its role in moisture recycling is often overlooked.
Degradation may significantly disturb rainfall patterns across South America.
The Amazon is vital for maintaining climatic stability both within and beyond its ecosystem.
The Amazon plays a crucial role in supporting South American agriculture.
questions.e: The passage highlights that through moisture recycling, the forest sustains its own balance and "influences rainfall patterns far beyond its boundaries," supporting regional climate stability and ecosystems across the continent.

questions.q: Q.48) Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ If M > N ≥ O = P ≤ Q < R then M is always greater than Q. 2️⃣ If X ≤ Y < Z and Z > W ≥ V then Y is always greater than V.
questions.e: In Statement I, since O=P ≤ Q and N ≥ O, Q can be larger than or equal to N, and thus equal to M. In Statement II, since Z is the common higher bound for both Y and V, there is no direct relationship preventing V from being equal to or greater than Y.

questions.q: Q.49) A group of 7 men and 8 robots can complete a job in 70% less time than 3 men and 2 robots. If 6 robots can finish the job in 4 days alone, how many days would it take for 3 men working alone?
questions.e: 6 robots finish in 4 days, so 1 robot rate is 1/24. Using the ratio of rates (where time is 30% of the other group), the math $7M + 8R = (3M + 2R)$ reveals $M = R$. Thus 1 man rate is 1/54. 3 men rate is 3/54 , taking 18 days.

questions.q: Q.50) If the day before yesterday was Monday, when will Friday be?
questions.e: If day before yesterday was Monday, then yesterday was Tuesday and today is Wednesday. Therefore, tomorrow is Thursday and the day after tomorrow is Friday.

questions.q: Q.1) The total fertility rate in an economy is defined as:
o: c) the birth rate minus death rate.
a) the number of children born per 1000 people in the population in a year.
b) the number of children born to a couple in their lifetime in a given population.
d) the average number of live births a woman would have by the end of her child-bearing age.
questions.e: The Total Fertility Rate (TFR) is the average number of children who would be born to any woman in her lifetime. It represents the average number of children a woman would have at the end of her reproductive period if she were subject to the fertility rates of a given period and not subject to mortality.

questions.q: Q.2) A software engineer leaves her job in Bengaluru to search for a higher-paying job in Hyderabad and remains jobless for three months during the transition. Which type of unemployment she faced during the three month period?
questions.e: Frictional unemployment occurs when a person is out of one job and is searching for another for reasons such as seeking a better job, being fired, or voluntarily quitting. It is temporary in nature as it requires some time before a person can get the next job.

questions.q: Q.3) Consider the following scenario: 1️⃣ Presently there is 6% unemployment rate in an economy and the inflation is stable. 2️⃣ If the unemployment rate rises to 7% then the inflation in the economy falls. 3️⃣ Also, if the unemployment rate decreases to 5% then inflation in the economy rises. Then in this scenario, the Non-Accelerating Inflation Rate of Unemployment (NAIRU) will be?
questions.e: NAIRU is the specific, lowest unemployment rate that can exist without causing inflation to rise or accelerate. When unemployment is at NAIRU, there is stability in the rate of inflation; departing from this rate causes acceleration or deceleration.

questions.q: Q.4) With reference to the International Labour Organisation (ILO), consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It was established under the Washington Treaty of 1945 to set and promote labor standards across the world. 2️⃣ It is the only tripartite U.N. agency which brings together government, employers and workers' representatives. 3️⃣ The World Employment and Social Outlook is a flagship report published by ILO. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The ILO was founded in 1919 by the Treaty of Versailles, not the Washington Treaty. It is the only tripartite U.N. agency, bringing together 187 Member States' governments, employers, and workers to set labor standards and policies.

questions.q: Q.5) With reference to the Convention on Cluster Munitions, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It is an international treaty that prohibits the use, development, production, acquisition, stockpiling, and transfer of cluster munitions under any circumstances. 2️⃣ India is a signatory to this convention. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The Convention on Cluster Munitions (CCM) strictly prohibits all activities related to cluster munitions to address humanitarian consequences. India is not a signatory to the convention, citing military and strategic considerations.

questions.q: Q.6) Alkire-Foster method, recently seen in news, is related to:
o: d) Measuring greenhouse gas emission per capita
questions.e: The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), also called the Alkire-Foster method, measures the levels and intensity of poverty based on health, education, and living standards. It identifies households as poor if their deprivation score is higher than 33 percent.

questions.q: Q.7) With reference to the e-Shram portal, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Each unorganized worker who is registered on the portal is assigned with a unique 12 digit Universal Account Number (UAN). 2️⃣ Its primary purpose is to facilitate delivery of welfare benefits and social security measures to unorganised sector workers across the country. 3️⃣ Once the worker registers to the e-shram portal he/she is provided with a financial incentive of Rs. 6000 which will be released in three equal installments. Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The e-Shram portal provides a 12-digit UAN to unorganized workers to facilitate access to social security schemes. There is no monetary or cash incentive provided solely for registering on the portal.

questions.q: Q.8) In the context of the Indian economy, which of the following is/are most likely to be included in the country's labour force? 1️⃣ A 25 year old unemployed person who is actively seeking work. 2️⃣ A 35 year old person who is working in a multinational company. 3️⃣ A 65 year old person working as a watchman at an ATM. 4️⃣ A 26-year-old student pursuing higher education in a university and presently not seeking any job opportunity. Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The labor force consists of both employed persons and those who are unemployed but seeking or available for work. Students not seeking work are classified as being outside the labour force.

questions.q: Q.9) In the context of Indian Economy, which of the following best describes the term "Silver Dividend"?
o: c) Economic gains due to the transition of the Ind...
b) The revenue earned by the government through ta...
d) The potential economic and social benefits aris...
a) The potential benefit that will arise with the...
questions.e: The Silver Dividend refers to the economic and social potential of an aging population. It emphasizes keeping elderly individuals active and engaged in economic and social roles as the 60-plus demographic grows.

questions.q: Q.10) The 'Bond Central' has been recently launched by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) with the primary objective of:
o: a) enabling foreign investors to invest in corpora...
d) providing information to the public regarding c...
c) providing a platform to retail investors that e...
b) channelizing financial resources of banks towar...
questions.e: Bond Central is a centralized database portal for corporate bonds in India. It was launched by SEBI to create a single, authentic source of information on such securities for the public.

questions.q: Q.11) Consider the following statements regarding Self-Help Groups (SHGs): 1️⃣ The SHG programme was originally initiated by the State Bank of India. 2️⃣ Banks provide the loan to the SHG as a whole and it is the collective responsibility of the members to repay. 3️⃣ Financial Inclusion Fund supports SCBs and RRBs for enabling Dual Authentication in microATMs for SHGs. Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The SHG movement was actually launched by NABARD in 1991-92, not SBI. Loans are a collective responsibility of the group, and the Dual Authentication feature in microATMs is a recent initiative to support SHG transactions.

questions.q: Q.12) With reference to Integrated Child Development scheme, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It is a central sector scheme. 2️⃣ One of its components is pre-school non-formal education to children aged between 3-6 years. 3️⃣ 'Household income below the Poverty Line' is the sole criteria for registration of beneficiaries under ICDS. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: ICDS is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, not a Central Sector Scheme. It provides a package of six services, including pre-school education, and is universal for all categories regardless of the Poverty Line.

questions.q: Q.13) Consider the following pairs: 1️⃣ Global Hunger Index: Food and Agricultural Organization. 2️⃣ The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World: Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe. 3️⃣ Child Nutrition Report: United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF). How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Only Pair III is correct. The Global Hunger Index is published by Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe. The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) is published by the FAO.

questions.q: Q.14) With reference to Janani Suraksha Yojana, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality. 2️⃣ One of its objective is to promote institutional deliveries among poor pregnant women. 3️⃣ Under the scheme universal public health facilities to sick infants up to one year of age will be provided. Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) focuses on safe delivery and immediate postnatal care to reduce mortality. It does not cover public health facilities for infants up to one year of age; its primary goal is promoting institutional delivery.

questions.q: Q.15) Which one of the following is a pull factor for migration?
questions.e: Pull factors are positive aspects that attract people to a new location. These include better work opportunities, higher wages, and improved health services, whereas disasters and low income are push factors.

questions.q: Q.16) Which of the following is the primary objective of the Tim Tim Taare (TTT) initiative?
o: b) To impart vocational education to school students through ITIs.
c) To impart essential life skills among adolescent students across India.
d) To impart necessary foundational literacy and numeracy among children before reaching grade 3.
a) To bridge the knowledge gap between students following different education curriculum.
questions.e: Tim Tim Taare (TTT) is an initiative highlighted in the Economic Survey 2024-25 that focuses on soft skills, emotional intelligence, and social well-being to empower adolescent students.

questions.q: Q.17) Consider the following statements with respect to moonlighting, recently seen in the news: 1️⃣ It refers to the practice of using false documentation and forged experience letters to secure a new job while continuing to work in an existing job. 2️⃣ In India the practice of moonlighting is explicitly prohibited under the Companies Act, 2013. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Moonlighting is working an extra job beyond regular hours without the employer's knowledge. It is not explicitly prohibited by a single central law like the Companies Act but is usually restricted by individual employment contracts.

questions.q: Q.18) As per NITI Aayog's National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) a household is considered deprived if: 1️⃣ not even one member of the household aged 10 years or older has completed six years of schooling. 2️⃣ a household cooks with dung, agricultural crops or coal. 3️⃣ any one the household member above the age of 18 years does not have a bank account or a post office account. 4️⃣ the household has no electricity. Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: a) I, II and IV only
d) I, II, III and IV
questions.e: A household is deprived in the bank account indicator only if *no* household member has an account. Statement III is incorrect because it claims deprivation if just *any one* member lacks an account.

questions.q: Q.19) With reference to Employment elasticity, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It depicts the relationship between GDP growth and employment generation in an economy. 2️⃣ If it is more than one, it indicates that the economy has achieved full employment. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Employment elasticity measures the percentage change in employment associated with a percentage change in GDP. A value over one means employment responds more than proportionately to GDP changes, not that full employment is reached.

questions.q: Q.20) With reference to the National Commission for Safai Karamcharis, which of the following statements is/are correct? 1️⃣ It is a statutory body functioning under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. 2️⃣ It is responsible for monitoring the implementation of The Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation Act, 2013. Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The NCSK is currently a non-statutory body (its statutory act expired in 2004) and it functions under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, not Housing and Urban Affairs.

questions.q: Q.21) Consider the following statements about the Rashtriya Gokul Mission: 1️⃣ It is important for the upliftment of rural poor as majority of low producing indigenous animals are with small and marginal farmers. 2️⃣ It was initiated to promote indigenous cattle and buffalo rearing and conservation in a scientific and holistic manner. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The mission aims to enhance the productivity of native breeds and improve rural livelihoods. It is crucial because over 80% of low-producing indigenous animals are owned by small farmers and landless laborers.

questions.q: Q.22) Which among the following curves is a graphical representation of income distribution among the population of a country and is used to analyse the degree of income or wealth inequality in an economy?
questions.e: The Lorenz curve plots the cumulative share of income against the cumulative share of the population. The degree of inequality is further quantified using the Gini Coefficient derived from this curve.

questions.q: Q.23) With reference to the methodology of poverty estimation in India which among the following recommended the updation of the poverty line in the future using the Fisher Index?
o: c) The Expert Group under the Chairmanship of Prof. D.T. Lakdawala
d) Task Force under the chairmanship of Dr. Y.K. Alagh
b) The Expert Group under the Chairmanship of Prof. Suresh D. Tendulkar
a) The Expert Group under the Chairmanship of Dr. C. Rangarajan
questions.e: The Rangarajan Committee  recommended a revised approach for determining the poverty line and specifically suggested using the Fisher Index for future updates to the poverty line.

questions.q: Q.24) As per Economic Survey 2025-26, between the years 2011 till 2024 arrange the following sectors in ascending order based on their employment elasticity: 1️⃣ Agriculture 2️⃣ Manufacturing 3️⃣ Construction 4️⃣ Services Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Based on 2011-2024 data, the order is Manufacturing (0.22), Agriculture (0.41), Services (0.43), and Construction (0.60). Construction has the highest elasticity, acting as a labour shock absorber.

questions.q: Q.25) In the context of Indian electoral system, the term 'D-Voter', recently seen in the news, refers to:
o: d) A deployed voter serving on election duty outside their home constituency.
c) A dormant voter who hasn't voted in multiple past elections.
b) A differently abled voter provided with special voting arrangements.
a) A doubtful voter whose Indian citizenship has not been verified.
questions.e: D-voters are individuals in Assam whose citizenship is unresolved. They are not allowed to vote, contest elections, or hold public office until their cases are cleared by Foreigners Tribunals.

questions.q: Q.26) Consider the following matches of Government Schemes and Nodal Ministries: 1️⃣ PM Vishwakarma: Ministry of Textiles. 2️⃣ DAY-NRLM: Ministry of Panchayati Raj. 3️⃣ PM SVANidhi: Ministry of Finance. In how many of the above rows is the information correctly matched?
questions.e: All are incorrect. PM Vishwakarma is under MSME; DAY-NRLM is under Ministry of Rural Development; and PM SVANidhi is under Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

questions.q: Q.27) The Global Gender Gap Report published by the World Economic Forum measures gender inequality across four key dimensions. Which of the following is not one of these dimensions?
questions.e: The four dimensions measured are Economic Participation and Opportunity, Educational Attainment, Health and Survival, and Political Empowerment. Digital empowerment is not one of the standard metrics used.

questions.q: Q.28) The targeted beneficiaries under PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN) scheme are:
o: d) the denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes...
b) the Scheduled Tribes residing in Fifth Schedule...
a) the tribal population residing in the North-Eas...
c) the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTG...
questions.e: PM JANMAN aims for the socio-economic development of 75 PVTG communities. It focuses on providing basic facilities like housing, water, and connectivity over a 3-year period.

questions.q: Q.29) With reference to the National Family Health Survey (NFHS), consider the following statements: 1️⃣ The National Statistical Organisation is the nodal agency for the survey. 2️⃣ As per NFHS-5, India's total fertility rate has fallen below the replacement level of fertility. 3️⃣ As per NFHS-5, Bihar has the highest Total Fertility Rate (TFR) among the states in India. Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) Mumbai is the nodal agency, not the NSO. NFHS-5 showed India's TFR at 2.0 (below the 2.1 replacement level) and Bihar at 3.0.

questions.q: Q.30) Which of the following is incorrect regarding the National Turmeric Board in India?
o: b) It functions under the Ministry of Commerce and...
c) It includes three members to represent turmeric...
d) One of the functions of the board is to promote...
a) It is a statutory body constituted under the Fa...
questions.e: The National Turmeric Board was established by an executive order of the Union Government, meaning it is a non-statutory body. Statement (a) is therefore incorrect.

questions.q: Q.31) Which of the following statements about 'Vibrant Village Programme' is/are correct? 1️⃣ It aims at comprehensive development of the identified villages. 2️⃣ Fairs, festivals, sports meet etc. are organized under this programme.
questions.e: This centrally sponsored scheme focuses on border villages to strengthen infrastructure and prevent outmigration. It also uses cultural events to foster social integration and a sense of national belonging.

questions.q: Q.32) In the context of Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY), an account can be opened for which of the following? 1️⃣ Priya, aged 5, only girl child. 2️⃣ Pooja, aged 8, has one elder sister with an SSY account. 3️⃣ Shanu, aged 7, has two elder sisters who both have SSY accounts. 4️⃣ Arpita, aged 9, only girl child but is an NRI.
o: d) Priya, Pooja, Shanu and Arpita
c) Priya, Pooja and Shanu only
questions.e: SSY accounts are limited to two girl children per family (except in cases of triplets/twins). NRIs are not eligible for the scheme, making Priya and Pooja the only eligible candidates.

questions.q: Q.33) Consider the following statements about health initiatives: 1️⃣ PM-JAY provides cashless cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family for secondary/tertiary care. 2️⃣ Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission creates an interoperable digital health ecosystem. 3️⃣ Ayushman Aarogya Mandirs ensure primary healthcare is accessible near homes. 4️⃣ PM-ABHIM aims to correct regional imbalances in medical education facilities. Which are correct?
o: d) I, II, III and IV
a) I, II and III only
questions.e: Statement IV describes the "Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana" (PMSSY). PM-ABHIM actually focuses on strengthening health infrastructure to respond to future pandemics.

questions.q: Q.34) Which of the following activities are examples of 'Human Capital Formation'? 1️⃣ A government-led initiative to provide specialized vocational training to rural artisans. 2️⃣ A company investing in comprehensive health insurance and medical check-ups for its employees. 3️⃣ A transport company adding a new fleet of electric buses to its existing operations.
questions.e: Human capital formation involves investing in people (skills, health, education). Buying electric buses is an investment in physical capital, not human capital.

questions.q: Q.35) The Hague Service Convention, recently seen in the news, primarily deals with:
o: d) Standardization of civil aviation safety norms
c) Supervision of diplomatic immunity and privileges
a) Settlement of international trade disputes
b) Transmission of legal documents across countries
questions.e: The Hague Service Convention  is a multilateral treaty that facilitates the transmission of judicial and extrajudicial documents in civil or commercial matters across international borders.

questions.q: Q.36) With reference to Sustainable Development Goals (SDG), consider the following: 1️⃣ Goal 2 (End hunger): PM Kisan Samman Nidhi. 2️⃣ Goal 5 (Education): Padhe Bharat Badhe Bharat. 3️⃣ Goal 6 (Water/Sanitation): PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana. 4️⃣ Goal 13 (Climate): National Solar Mission. How many rows are correctly matched?
questions.e: Row II is incorrect because Goal 5 is Gender Equality. Quality Education is Goal 4. Padhe Bharat Badhe Bharat targets Goal 4, not Goal 5.

questions.q: Q.37) With reference to the Indian Economy, which of the following best describes a "Living Wage"?
o: d) The level of pay that enables workers and their families to maintain a decent standard of living.
a) It is the legally mandated minimum remuneration that an employer must pay.
c) The wage that is considered reasonable for the type of work performed.
b) An income earned by a single worker sufficient to meet the needs of the entire household.
questions.e: A living wage covers basic needs like food, housing, healthcare, and education to ensure a decent standard of living. It differs from a minimum wage, which is simply the legal floor for pay.

questions.q: Q.38) In a country, 'Natural Population Change' over a period of time can be known through:
o: a) adding the total number of live births and total number of inward migrants.
b) calculating the net difference between the inward migration rate and outward migration rate.
c) calculating the difference between the birth rate and the death rate.
d) adding the net difference of migration to the difference of birth/death rates.
questions.e: Natural population change is strictly the difference between births and deaths. Induced growth, on the other hand, includes migration factors like immigration and emigration.

questions.q: Q.39) NPS Vatsalya, a contributory savings scheme designed exclusively for minors, is administered by:
o: b) Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
d) The National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
c) Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority
questions.e: NPS Vatsalya is regulated and administered by PFRDA. It is designed for Indian minor citizens up to age 18 to encourage long-term retirement savings from an early age.

questions.q: Q.40) With reference to the Middle East, the Netzarim Corridor, recently seen in the news, is situated in:
questions.e: The Netzarim Corridor is a strategic military zone in the central Gaza Strip. It stretches from the border to the Mediterranean Sea, effectively dividing Gaza into north and south parts.

questions.q: Q.41) Which of the following strategies is/are adopted for implementing the POSHAN Abhiyaan? 1️⃣ Inter-sectoral convergence for better service delivery. 2️⃣ Use of technology (ICT) for real-time growth monitoring of women and children.
questions.e: POSHAN Abhiyaan uses inter-sectoral convergence (health, education, water) and technology (like the Poshan Tracker) to monitor and improve nutritional outcomes across the country.

questions.q: Q.42) Consider the following pairs: 1️⃣ SEQI: NCERT. 2️⃣ ASER: NGO Pratham Education Foundation. 3️⃣ National Achievement Survey: NITI Aayog. How many pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Only pair II is correct. SEQI is developed by NITI Aayog, not NCERT. The National Achievement Survey (NAS) is conducted by NCERT, not NITI Aayog.

questions.q: Q.43) What is a difference between MGNREGA and the Viksit Bharat-G RAM G Act, 2025? 1️⃣ MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days of work; VB-G RAM G guarantees 125 days. 2️⃣ VB-G RAM G permits a 60-day "pause window" during peak seasons. 3️⃣ MGNREGA mandated social audits, but VB-G RAM G does not.
questions.e: Both acts mandate social audits by the Gram Sabha. Statement III is incorrect because the VB-G RAM G Act preserves and institutionalizes the social audit requirement.

questions.q: Q.44) With reference to the National Career Service (NCS), consider the following: 1️⃣ It helps Indian citizens seek employment opportunities both in India and abroad. 2️⃣ In partnership with Microsoft India, it launched the Digisaksham initiative. Which are correct?
questions.e: The NCS portal integrates with the eMigrate system for international jobs and partnered with Microsoft for Digisaksham to impart digital skills to rural and disadvantaged youth.

questions.q: Q.45) The Grameen Credit Score Initiative is primarily aimed at:
o: b) promoting financial inclusion of Self-Help Groups
d) promoting refinancing of micro finance institutions
a) providing housing loans at cheaper interest rates
c) providing loan waivers to poor and marginal farmers
questions.e: Announced in Budget 2025-26, this initiative formalizes SHG transactions within the credit system. It helps public-sector banks assess the creditworthiness of rural women and entrepreneurs.

questions.q: Q.46) Amit started reading a 245-page book on Monday, reading 10 pages more each day than the previous. He finished before next Monday. On which day did he finish?
questions.e: Let Monday be $x$. The sum for 5 days is $x + (x+10) + (x+20) + (x+30) + (x+40) = 5x + 100$. Setting $5x + 100 = 245$ gives $x=29$. Since $x$ is a whole number, he finished in 5 days (Friday).

questions.q: Q.47) Let x, y be distinct odd primes and a, b be distinct even positive integers ($x>y$, $a>b$). 1️⃣ $(x-y)^a + (a-b)^x$ is always divisible by 4. 2️⃣ $x(a+b)+y(a-b)$ is never divisible by 4. 3️⃣ $(x+a)^2 \times (y+b)$ is always an odd integer. Which are correct?
questions.e: Statement II is false because if $x=5, y=3, a=4, b=2$, the result is 36, which is divisible by 4. Statements I and III follow basic even/odd arithmetic rules.

questions.q: Q.48) Question: Is the average of the largest and smallest of 4 numbers ($a \le b \le c \le d$) greater than the average of all 4? 1️⃣ $d-c < b-a$. 2️⃣ $d-a > c-b$. Which is correct?
o: a) The Question can be answered by one of the Statements alone but not by the other.
b) The Question can be answered by either Statement alone.
d) The Question cannot be answered even using both.
c) The Question can be answered by using both together only.
questions.e: Statement I simplifies to $a+d < b+c$, meaning the average of the extremes is less than the total average, answering the question. Statement II does not define the relationship between $(a+d)$ and $(b+c)$.

questions.q: Q.49) Which statement best reflects the critical message of Passage-1 regarding screen time among older adults?
o: b) Increased screen time is lowering productivity and promoting sedentary habits among older adults.
c) Adults need to consciously regulate their screen time to maintain productivity.
a) Endless scrolling on smartphones consumes a substantial portion of adults' productive time.
d) Adults should quit social media as it prioritises engagement over meaningful content.
questions.e: The passage highlights how smartphone design and convenience lead to a cumulative rise in lifestyle-related risks, low productivity, and reduced physical activity among the elderly.

questions.q: Q.50) Based on the passage, which assumptions are valid? 1️⃣ Screen time is rising among older adults while decreasing among the young. 2️⃣ Loneliness among older adults contributes to increased reliance on smartphones.
questions.e: The passage explicitly mentions smartphones as a way to "manage loneliness." It mentions rising screen time for older adults but provides no data or comparison regarding younger generations.

questions.q: Q.1) In the recent past, which of the above airports have been constructed as Greenfield project? 1️⃣ Donyi Polo Airport 2️⃣ Kushinagar International Airport 3️⃣ Vijayawada International Airport
questions.e: Since 2019, 6 Greenfield airports including Kushinagar and Itanagar (Donyi Polo) have been operationalised. Donyi Polo Airport is the first greenfield airport in Arunachal Pradesh. Vijayawada International airport is not a greenfield project.

questions.q: Q.2) With reference to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Sector, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Globally, MSMEs are responsible for over 50 per cent of the total global employment. 2️⃣ In India, MSMEs are the second-largest employer after agriculture. 3️⃣ In India, MSMEs contribute to over 45% of the country's exports.
questions.e: Globally, MSMEs make up about 90% of businesses and over 50% of employment. In India, the sector employs over 32.82 crore persons, ranking second after agriculture, and accounts for approximately 48.58% of exports.

questions.q: Q.3) The Backward Value Added in Exports (BVAX) ratio measures:
o: b) the share of total domestic value added in gross exports.
a) the share of exported components in gross import.
c) the share of foreign value added in gross exports.
d) the share of total value of agricultural raw materials in gross exports.
questions.e: The BVAX ratio indicates the extent to which a country's exports rely on imported intermediate inputs. It represents the share of foreign value added embodied in a country's gross exports, which stood at 17.2% for India in 2020.

questions.q: Q.4) Which of the following statements best describes the term 'servicification' in the manufacturing sector?
o: d) The outsourcing of the core manufacturing activ...
a) The process of replacing manual labor in produc...
c) The gradual replacement of the traditional manu...
b) The increasing utilization of services in manuf...
questions.e: Servicification means the manufacturing sector increasingly relies on services as inputs (R&D, logistics) or as outputs bundled with goods (maintenance, software support). It also includes the expansion of in-house service activities within firms.

questions.q: Q.5) With reference to India's steel sector, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ India is the world's second-largest producer of crude steel. 2️⃣ India is self-sufficient in iron ore and coking coal, which are primary raw materials used in crude steel production.
o: a) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains Statement I
c) Statement I is correct but Statement II is not correct
b) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct but Statement II does not explain Statement I
d) Statement I is not correct but Statement II is correct
questions.e: India is indeed the world's second-largest crude steel producer as of 2024-25. However, while India is largely self-sufficient in iron ore, it remains heavily dependent on imports for coking coal.

questions.q: Q.6) Presently, which of the above is/are deepwater Container Transhipment Port in India? 1️⃣ Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Maharashtra 2️⃣ V. O. Chidambaranar Port, Tamil Nadu 3️⃣ Vizhinjam International Seaport, Kerala
questions.e: Vizhinjam International Seaport in Kerala is India's first dedicated deepwater container transhipment hub and the first Greenfield port project initiated by a state government. Neither JNPT nor V.O.C. Port currently holds this specific status.

questions.q: Q.7) With reference to the 'Orange Economy', recently seen in the news, consider the following activities: 1️⃣ Animation and Visual Effects (VFX) 2️⃣ Traditional tribal crafts and handloom 3️⃣ Poultry processing through automation 4️⃣ Live Music Concerts
o: d) I, II, III and IV
a) I, II and IV only
questions.e: The Orange Economy refers to activities based on creativity, culture, and intellectual property. Poultry processing belongs to the "Pink Revolution" (industrial food processing) and is not considered a creative or cultural industry.

questions.q: Q.8) With reference to the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It is a statutory body. 2️⃣ It acts as an apex body to provide high-level strategic direction of scientific research in the country as per recommendations of the National Education Policy. 3️⃣ Research, Development and Innovation Fund (RDIF) is a Special Purpose Fund under ANRF.
questions.e: ANRF is a statutory body established via the ANRF Act 2023. it follows NEP 2020 recommendations to guide scientific research. The RDIF is a special-purpose fund under the foundation to support innovation.

questions.q: Q.9) Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Investments made by mutual funds in units of Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) are classified as equity-related instruments. 2️⃣ REIT units represent direct ownership of immovable property, similar to purchasing physical real estate.
o: c) Statement I is correct, but Statement II is not correct
a) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains Statement I
d) Statement I is not correct, but Statement II is correct
b) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct, but Statement II does not explain Statement I
questions.e: SEBI classifies Mutual Fund investments in REITs as equity-related instruments. However, REIT investors do not own the physical property directly; they own units of a trust that manages the assets and distributes rental income.

questions.q: Q.10) In the context of defence technology, Sonobuoys, recently seen in the news, are:
o: c) Underwater mines equipped with motion sensors for naval defence.
b) Electro-mechanical acoustic devices used for detecting submarines.
a) Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) designed for coastal surveillance.
d) Surface-to-air missile systems deployed on naval destroyers.
questions.e: Sonobuoys are expendable acoustic devices used in Anti-Submarine Warfare to locate enemy submarines. They are also used for oceanographic studies and marine biology research.

questions.q: Q.11) Capital deepening refers to
o: a) going for more fixed capital per worker
b) emphasis on social overhead capita
questions.e: Capital deepening is the process of increasing the amount of fixed capital (machinery, infrastructure) per worker. This augmentation is intended to heighten productivity and foster economic growth.

questions.q: Q.12) Consider the following scenario in a country X - While insurance density has risen steadily to $97 in FY 2025 the insurance penetration has declined to 3.7 per cent. The above scenario best reflects-
o: c) the average life insurance premiums paid per pe...
d) The rate of growth of the country's population...
a) the average insurance premium paid per person i...
b) the total number of unique policyholders in the...
questions.e: Insurance density is the per capita premium (premium/population), while penetration is the ratio of premium to GDP. A rise in density with a fall in penetration means people are spending more on average, but the total market share relative to the economy is shrinking.

questions.q: Q.13) The relevant provisions of how many of the above acts/laws have been consolidated into the Industrial Relations Code, 2020? 1️⃣ Trade Unions Act, 1926 2️⃣ The Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 3️⃣ Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act 1946 4️⃣ The Factories Act, 1948 5️⃣ The Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970
questions.e: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 consolidated only three acts: Trade Unions Act , Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act , and Industrial Disputes Act . The others belong to Social Security or Occupational Safety codes.

questions.q: Q.14) Which of the following is the correct descending order of the industries based on their weightage under the Index of Eight core industries (as of December 2025)? 1️⃣ Petroleum Refinery Production 2️⃣ Natural Gas production 3️⃣ Coal production 4️⃣ Electricity generation
questions.e: The weights are: Refinery Products (28.04%), Electricity (19.85%), Coal (10.33%), and Natural Gas (6.88%). Thus, the correct descending order is I-IV-III-II.

questions.q: Q.15) Which of the following statements are correct regarding the recently launched 'Cali Fund'? 1️⃣ It will support the actions that are aimed at meeting the objectives of Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF). 2️⃣ At least 50 per cent of the resources of the Cali Fund will be allocated to fulfill the needs of indigenous peoples and local communities. 3️⃣ The Fund will receive mandatory contributions from private sector entities that are benefitting from global biodiversity. 4️⃣ It will be jointly managed and hosted by the World Bank and the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
o: d) I, II, III and IV
c) I, II and III only
questions.e: The Cali Fund is managed by UNDP and UNEP, not the World Bank/IUCN. It collects money from businesses using Digital Sequence Information (DSI) to support KMGBF goals, with 50% reserved for indigenous communities.

questions.q: Q.16) In the context of Indian economy, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Statement I: Presently, India is the largest mobile phone manufacturer globally. 2️⃣ Statement II: Production Linked Incentive Scheme has encouraged major smartphone companies to shift their production to India.
o: b) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct but Statement II does not explain Statement I
d) Statement I is not correct but Statement II is correct
c) Statement I is correct but Statement II is not correct
a) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains Statement I
questions.e: India is the second-largest mobile phone manufacturer globally, not the first. The PLI scheme (4% to 6% incentive) has successfully encouraged many foreign and domestic firms to establish local manufacturing plants.

questions.q: Q.17) With reference to Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS), consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It would help in providing collateral free debt funding to eligible startups. 2️⃣ Venture Debt Funds (VDFs) under SEBI registered Alternative Investment Funds are eligible as lending/investing institutions under the scheme.
questions.e: CGSS provides credit guarantees up to Rs. 20 crore to enable collateral-free debt (loans/venture debt). Member Institutions include banks, NBFCs, and SEBI-registered Venture Debt Funds.

questions.q: Q.18) Which of the following entities is/are eligible to be recognized as startup or deep tech startup by DPIIT? 1️⃣ Company A (8 years old, Pvt Ltd, <150cr turnover) 2️⃣ Company B (13 years old, R&D focus, <150cr turnover) 3️⃣ Company C (2 years old, Coop Society, dairy tech, <150cr turnover)
questions.e: Regular startups are recognized up to 10 years (turnover <200cr). Deep Tech startups have a higher limit of 20 years and 300cr turnover. Recently, cooperative societies have also been made eligible for recognition.

questions.q: Q.19) How many of the above are provided Copyright protection in India under Copyright Act, 1957? 1️⃣ Computer software or programme 2️⃣ Cinematograph films 3️⃣ Mathematical concepts 4️⃣ Original Literary Works
questions.e: Copyright protects original literary (including software), dramatic, musical, artistic works, and films. However, it protects expressions, not ideas or mathematical concepts as such.

questions.q: Q.20) With reference to production of coffee in India, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ India is the world's third largest producer of coffee. 2️⃣ India produces a much higher quantity of Arabica Coffee as compared to Robusta. 3️⃣ Karnataka is the largest coffee producing State accounting for more than 50% of India's total coffee production.
questions.e: India is the 7th or 8th largest producer, not 3rd. Robusta makes up 72% of production, exceeding Arabica. Karnataka is the leader, contributing 71% of India's total coffee.

questions.q: Q.21) Which one among the following defines flexi workers in India?
o: c) Agricultural labour migrating to urban areas
d) Regular salaried workers working in registered companies
b) Informal sector employees working in urban areas
a) Formal contract staff employed through organised contract
questions.e: Flexi-workers are formal contract staff employed through organized contractual arrangements rather than permanent payrolls. This model allows companies to adjust workforce needs based on specific projects or timelines.

questions.q: Q.22) Which of the above is/are not included under the definition of the Services under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019? 1️⃣ Legal services rendered by the lawyer in a court case. 2️⃣ Free medical service provided by a doctor in a rural area. 3️⃣ Supply of electricity by the government owned discom.
questions.e: The Act excludes services rendered free of charge or under a contract of personal service. The Supreme Court recently clarified that legal services by lawyers are outside the CPA's ambit. Electricity supply is explicitly included as a service.

questions.q: Q.23) The Public Private Partnership Appraisal Committee (PPPAC) functions under which one of the following departments of the Government of India?

questions.q: Q.31) Which of the following statements is/are true with respect to Phillips Curve? 1️⃣ It shows the trade-off between unemployment and inflation. 2️⃣ The downward sloping curve is generally held to be valid only in the short run. 3️⃣ In the long run, it is horizontal at the Non-Accelerating Inflation Rate of Unemployment (NAIRU).
o: [cite_start]Ex: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; there is an inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment in the short run[cite: 791, 793]. [cite_start]Statement 3 is incorrect because in the long run, the Phillips Curve is thought to shift vertically, not stay horizontal[cite: 797].
